method: Rendered every page of the three booklets with music_pages.py render at 110 dpi (listening 1-16, composing 1-16, elective 1-8) and read every ask page in full; confirmed on contact sheets that listening 1, 7, 12-16, composing 1, 2, 12-16 and elective 1, 3-8 carry no question text (covers, BLANK PAGE, ROUGH WORK, answer lines). Dumped every text-layer span with its font (PyMuPDF) on listening 2-6, 8-11, composing 3-11 and elective 2, and zoomed with PyMuPDF clips at 260-400 dpi on: the Q2 German/English columns (umlauts, ’ in man’s and Tho’, “ ” quotes, Verlässt with ss), composing Q1 "16–bar" (en dash) against Q3 "16-bar" (hyphen), Q3 AA¹BB¹. (two 6pt "1" spans, no space), Q5 "F♯ minor" and Q6 "E♭ major" (OpusChordsStd # / b drawn as raised signs, a word space before minor/major), elective Q2 "Full details" (the text layer has no space after bold Full; the page prints one), Q5 A Excerpt 1(i)'s italic closing full stop, Q4(v)'s double space and “mock opera”, the Q6 Excerpt 3 lyric block (A - - - - - men, five hyphens), and the Q1 Excerpt 3 heading ("Bars 1–9 ... printed below", no closing stop). Bullets checked on the render: Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 and Q6 lead-ins and the Q6 Excerpt 3 heading print bullets; Q5 A and Q5 B print none; composing bullets as printed, PREPARATORY WORK in regular capitals with no bullet; elective Q4(b) four bullets. Typed the printed text of every in-scope field into a script (lead-in bullets "\n• ", composing/elective bullets " • ", tick boxes "□ ", unbulleted lines joined with a space, "\n" between the two Q6 Excerpt 3(ii) and (iv) stems either side of their options, Q5 B grid.stem per the 19 Nov evening ruling) and compared every file string exactly, with no normalisation; then checked all 4,406 word tokens of the file strings, case and punctuation included, against the text layer of the ask's pages (only AA¹BB¹. is split in the text layer, confirmed on the render); then listed the code point of every non-ASCII character in the file strings (¹ U+00B9, ä U+00E4, ö U+00F6, ü U+00FC, – U+2013, ’ U+2019, “ U+201C, ” U+201D, • U+2022, □ U+25A1, ♭ U+266D, ♯ U+266F). The file has no readFromPage entries. Elective Q2-Q4(b) carry no grid (shared card e-q1-q4 on Q1), so no grid.stem there; Q5 B questionContext is null (its lead-in is in grid.stem). Every address matches the printed numbering (Q1, Q5 A and Q6 number their parts afresh under each excerpt; elective "4.(a)" / "(b)" read as Q4(a) / Q4(b)). Every tick-box option list is carried in its ask's figure.
